families.failure_mode: Breakout is a liquidity vacuum that immediately reverts (failed breakout).
families.falsification: No positive net edge over cost after compression-conditioning across folds.
families.hypothesis: Breakouts of a causal Donchian channel are informative only when they follow a range-compression regime, not in already-trending noise.
families.mechanism: Enter on close beyond the prior N-bar high/low conditioned on range_compression being in a low percentile; exit on time or opposite channel.

families.failure_mode: Trend is already priced; slope t-stat is autocorrelation of noise.
families.falsification: Slope-sign edge indistinguishable from zero after vol-scaling and cost.
families.hypothesis: Volatility-scaled multi-scale trend persists intraday within a session.
families.mechanism: Sign-consistent OLS slope t-stat across two lookbacks, position scaled by inverse realized vol; flat by NY close.

families.failure_mode: Pullback is the start of a reversal, not a continuation.
families.falsification: Pullback entries do not beat trend-only entries net of cost.
families.hypothesis: A longer-horizon trend with a shorter-horizon counter-move gives a better entry than chasing the breakout.
families.mechanism: Gate on positive multi-hour trend_slope; enter on short-horizon mom_zscore pullback against the trend; exit on trend resumption or time.

families.failure_mode: Overshoot is trend continuation in a regime shift; reversion never comes.
families.falsification: No reversion edge survives spread cost at realistic entry thresholds.
families.hypothesis: Short-horizon overshoots beyond a rolling equilibrium mean-revert.
families.mechanism: Enter against dist_from_ewma z-score beyond a band; exit on reversion to zero or time; abstain in high-vol regime.

families.failure_mode: Half-life estimate is unstable and look-back biased.
families.falsification: Reversion conditioned on half-life is no better than unconditional.
families.hypothesis: Series with a short estimated OU half-life revert predictably; long half-life does not.
families.mechanism: Estimate rolling OU half-life; trade reversion only when half-life is inside a tradeable band; size by distance in z-units.

families.failure_mode: Expansion direction is random; compression only predicts magnitude not sign.
families.falsification: Directional expansion edge is zero after cost; only |move| is predictable.
families.hypothesis: Volatility compression precedes directional expansion (regime transition).
families.mechanism: Detect low parkinson_vol percentile; arm a straddle-style directional break; enter on first expansion bar in the break direction.

families.failure_mode: Spread state is endogenous to the move; gating removes the profitable tail.
families.falsification: Spread-gating does not improve net edge vs ungated reversion.
families.hypothesis: Reversals are only tradeable when the quoted spread is compressed; abnormal spread marks toxic liquidity to avoid.
families.mechanism: Compute spread_zscore; gate mean-reversion entries to low-spread state; veto during abnormal-spread spikes.

families.failure_mode: M1 volume is a tick-volume proxy, not a quote count.
families.falsification: REJECTED pre-outcome: tick arrival unsupported; never faked from M1.
families.hypothesis: Quote-arrival clustering (event-time intensity) predicts short-horizon direction.
families.mechanism: Requires true tick arrival times / durations; not derivable from M1 bars.

families.failure_mode: No order-book depth exists in Dukascopy M1/tick.
families.hypothesis: Top-of-book size imbalance predicts micro-price drift.
families.mechanism: Requires L2 depth; not present in the acquired dataset.

families.failure_mode: Open-window edge is an artefact of wide spreads at the open.
families.falsification: No residual edge once open-window spread cost is charged.
families.hypothesis: Directional edge concentrates around London/NY session opens; the calendar cell is a conditioning variable, not a standalone signal.
families.mechanism: Use session_cell to gate a momentum trigger to the open window; cost-gate entries.

families.failure_mode: Factor estimated with error; residual carries factor leakage.
families.falsification: Beta-neutral residual reversion is zero net of cost across the panel.
families.hypothesis: After removing the common USD factor, single-pair residuals mean-revert.
families.mechanism: Build synchronized return panel; extract usd_factor; trade factor_residual reversion on a beta-neutral basis.

families.failure_mode: Cross-sectional FX momentum is weak and crowded; carry-driven.
families.falsification: No rank-portfolio spread net of cost and (unsupported) financing.
families.hypothesis: Relative momentum across the currency cross-section continues over days.
families.mechanism: Rank pairs by risk-adjusted trailing return; long top / short bottom, currency- and beta-neutral; rebalance daily.

families.failure_mode: Residual is dominated by non-synchronous quotes and spread, not arbitrage.
families.falsification: Residual reversion edge disappears once all three legs' spreads are charged.
families.hypothesis: The triangular no-arbitrage residual of three independently-quoted legs reverts.
families.mechanism: Compute triangle_residual z-score from three acquired legs; trade reversion when the residual is stationary (rolling ADF gate); size in z-units.

families.failure_mode: Cointegration is a full-sample artefact; breaks out of sample.
families.falsification: Prospectively-eligible spreads do not revert net of cost and financing.
families.hypothesis: A cointegrated pair with a Kalman-filtered dynamic hedge ratio has a stationary spread that reverts over days.
families.mechanism: Prospectively eligible pairs only; Kalman filter the hedge ratio causally; trade spread z-score reversion; embargo/purge on refit.

families.failure_mode: Filter parameters overfit; filtered slope lags.
families.falsification: Filtered-slope edge no better than simple vol-scaled momentum.
families.hypothesis: A local-level/local-trend state-space model extracts a causal trend cleaner than a moving average.
families.mechanism: Filtered (not smoothed) local-trend state from a fixed-parameter Kalman filter; trade the sign of the filtered slope; vol-scaled.

families.failure_mode: Change-points are detected too late to trade; false positives dominate.
families.falsification: Post-change-point trend edge is zero net of cost.
families.hypothesis: A causal change-point in the return/vol process marks the start of a tradeable regime.
families.mechanism: Online (filtered) change-point probability from a fixed prior; on a detected shift, trade the new-regime trend for a bounded holding window.

families.failure_mode: Regime is unstable; conditioning adds a hidden degree of freedom.
families.falsification: Regime-conditioning does not improve any base family's net edge.
families.hypothesis: Signal edge is regime-dependent; a frozen causal volatility-quantile regime selects when a base signal is active.
families.mechanism: Causal expanding volatility quantile bins define regime; used only as a gate on other families (see composition grammar), never traded alone.

families.failure_mode: Cost gate removes exactly the trades that carried the edge.
families.falsification: Sparse cost-gated entries do not beat the ungated base net of cost.
families.hypothesis: Trading is a decision under cost: enter only when expected net edge exceeds expected round-trip cost plus edge uncertainty.
families.mechanism: Compute expected_gross_edge from a base signal, expected_round_trip_cost from live spread, and an edge-uncertainty band; trade only if edge >= k * cost.

families.failure_mode: Meta-model overfits; calibration drifts out of sample.
families.falsification: Meta-filtered net edge no better than a fixed cost gate.
families.hypothesis: A calibrated logistic meta-labeller filters a base signal's trades by predicted probability that the move exceeds round-trip cost.
families.mechanism: Base signal proposes trades; expanding-window logistic model (purged/embargoed, frozen features/target/seed) predicts cost-exceedance; trade only above a frozen probability threshold, else abstain.
